007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model;
008
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude;
010import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
011import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies;
012import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonNaming;
013
014/**
015 * Object descriptor used in synthetic data generation object lists.
016 * <p>
017 * Each descriptor carries owner/schema and object-name values for one
018 * synthetic-data object-list entry. It can also specify an exact record count,
019 * a percentage-based record count, and user guidance for synthetic data
020 * generation.
021 *
022 * <p>
023 * The SDK performs basic, deterministic validation where the constraint can
024 * be evaluated independently of Oracle Database. The {@code owner} value must
025 * not be null or blank. The {@code name} value is preserved as supplied so
026 * database-side object-list validation remains authoritative. {@code recordCount} and
027 * {@code recordCountPercentage}, when specified, must be greater than zero.
028 * Invalid values detected by the SDK result in an
029 * {@link IllegalArgumentException}.
030 *
031 * <p>
032 * Database-specific and database-version-specific semantic validation,
033 * including validation of attribute combinations, is delegated to
034 * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI} and Oracle Database. Therefore, an object descriptor
035 * that passes SDK validation may still be rejected by the database based on
036 * the requested operation or other database-side requirements.
037 *
038 * <p>
039 * See the {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI} documentation for the complete and current
040 * definition of synthetic-data {@code object_list} parameters and their
041 * supported behavior.
042 *
043 * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/en/cloud/paas/autonomous-database/serverless/adbsb/dbms-cloud-ai-package.html#object_list-parameters">
044 *      DBMS_CLOUD_AI object_list Parameters</a>
045 */
046@JsonInclude(JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL)
047@JsonNaming(PropertyNamingStrategies.SnakeCaseStrategy.class)
048public final class SyntheticDataObjectList {
049
050    /** Database user/schema that owns the target database object. */
051    private final String owner;
052
053    /** Target database object name. */
054    private final String name;
055
056    /** Exact number of records to generate. */
057    private final Integer recordCount;
058
059    /** Percentage-based record count for generation. */
060    private final Integer recordCountPercentage;
061
062    /** Object-specific guidance for synthetic data generation. */
063    private final String userPrompt;
064
065    private SyntheticDataObjectList(Builder builder) {
066        this.owner = builder.owner;
067        this.name = builder.name;
068        this.recordCount = builder.recordCount;
069        this.recordCountPercentage = builder.recordCountPercentage;
070        this.userPrompt = builder.userPrompt;
071    }
072
073    /**
074     * Returns the target object owner/schema.
075     *
076     * @return target object owner/schema
077     */
078    public String getOwner() {
079        return owner;
080    }
081
082    /**
083     * Returns the target object name.
084     *
085     * @return target object name
086     */
087    public String getName() {
088        return name;
089    }
090
091    /**
092     * Returns the exact requested record count.
093     *
094     * @return exact requested record count, or {@code null} when unset
095     */
096    public Integer getRecordCount() {
097        return recordCount;
098    }
099
100    /**
101     * Returns the percentage-based requested record count.
102     *
103     * @return percentage requested record count, or {@code null} when unset
104     */
105    public Integer getRecordCountPercentage() {
106        return recordCountPercentage;
107    }
108
109    /**
110     * Returns object-specific generation guidance.
111     *
112     * @return user prompt, or {@code null} when unset
113     */
114    public String getUserPrompt() {
115        return userPrompt;
116    }
117
118
119    /**
120     * Creates a builder for a synthetic-data object descriptor.
121     *
122     * <p>The SDK validates that {@code owner} is not null or blank. The
123     * {@code name} value is preserved as supplied. Other database-specific
124     * semantics are validated by
125     * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI} and Oracle Database.</p>
126     *
127     * @param owner database user/schema that owns the target object
128     * @param name target object name, or {@code null} when the database should
129     *        apply object-list semantics for the supplied owner
130     * @return builder initialized with the owner and object name
131     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if {@code owner} is null or blank
132     */
133    public static Builder builder(String owner, String name) {
134        return new Builder(owner, name);
135    }
136
137    /**
138     * Builder for {@link SyntheticDataObjectList}.
139     */
140    public static final class Builder {
141        /** Required target object owner/schema. */
142        private final String owner;
143        /** Target object name being assembled. */
144        private final String name;
145        /** Exact record count being assembled. */
146        private Integer recordCount;
147        /** Percentage record count being assembled. */
148        private Integer recordCountPercentage;
149        /** User prompt being assembled. */
150        private String userPrompt;
151
152        private Builder(String owner, String name) {
153            if (owner == null || owner.isBlank()) {
154                throw new IllegalArgumentException("owner must not be null or blank");
155            }
156            this.owner = owner;
157            this.name = name;
158        }
159
160        /**
161         * Sets the exact number of records to generate.
162         *
163         * @param recordCount positive record count
164         * @return this builder instance
165         */
166        public Builder recordCount(Integer recordCount) {
167            if (recordCount != null && recordCount <= 0) {
168                throw new IllegalArgumentException("recordCount must be greater than 0");
169            }
170            this.recordCount = recordCount;
171            return this;
172        }
173
174        /**
175         * Sets the percentage-based record count.
176         *
177         * @param recordCountPercentage positive percentage value
178         * @return this builder instance
179         */
180        public Builder recordCountPercentage(Integer recordCountPercentage) {
181            if (recordCountPercentage != null && recordCountPercentage <= 0) {
182                throw new IllegalArgumentException("recordCountPercentage must be greater than 0");
183            }
184            this.recordCountPercentage = recordCountPercentage;
185            return this;
186        }
187
188        /**
189         * Sets object-specific guidance for synthetic data generation.
190         * <p>
191         * Null is omitted from the generated JSON. Non-null values, including
192         * blank strings, are preserved as supplied by the caller.
193         *
194         * @param userPrompt generation guidance
195         * @return this builder instance
196         */
197        public Builder userPrompt(String userPrompt) {
198            this.userPrompt = userPrompt;
199            return this;
200        }
201
202        /**
203         * Builds the object descriptor.
204         * <p>
205         * Count-related values are passed through as supplied after basic
206         * positive-number validation. Database-specific combinations are
207         * delegated to {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI}.
208         *
209         * @return immutable SyntheticDataObjectList
210         */
211        public SyntheticDataObjectList build() {
212            return new SyntheticDataObjectList(this);
213        }
214
215        /**
216         * Serializes the current builder state as a JSON object.
217         *
218         * @return JSON representation of current builder state
219         */
220        public String toJson() {
221            try {
222                ObjectMapper mapper = new ObjectMapper();
223                mapper.setPropertyNamingStrategy(PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE);
224                mapper.setSerializationInclusion(JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL);
225                return mapper.writeValueAsString(build());
226            } catch (Exception e) {
227                throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to serialize SyntheticDataObjectList", e);
228            }
229        }
230    }
231}
